create_UI_class: create a UI instance for the rearrange_v2 HITL app with world, sim, and controller dependencies
pick_object: pick up a rigid object in the simulation by double-clicking on a visible pickable object
place_object: place the currently held object onto a valid receptacle surface by releasing right-click
interact_with_object: open or close an interactable object like a drawer or cabinet door by double-clicking
draw_ui_highlights: draw visual highlights for pickable objects, hovered objects, and selected objects in the scene
